title: 'Project Runway' season 21 premieres Thursday: Everything you need to know - NewsBreak
text: "Project Runway" is back, bringing more fashion and excitement to the runway! Season 21 sees the return of original host Heidi Klum , joined by a dynamic group of new designers, including returning alums, a drag superstar, twin brothers and more. "It's just tough love," teased Law Roach, a new judge on the season, during his interview with " Good Morning America ." "Because cultivating the next generation of talent is really important to me, and it always has been. I would be doing them a disservice if I was sugar coating things. So, you know, I give it to them the way the real world gives it to you, there's no, you, know, soft parenting." Christian Siriano , season 4 winner and mentor on the show, added, "I mean this season it's really, I think they're really talented designers that I've, I mean they're making incredible things and I think what people forget is it, it really is 15 hours, sometimes 10 hours, they get no time, they create incredible things, and then we have to judge them, you know, it's a hard show." "I know what it is like and I know what it's like to be in the real world in fashion too. So you do get judged pretty harshly. I mean, there's gonna be an actress that is like, 'I hate that dress, I'm never wearing it.' So they have to hear that," Siriano said. "But it's so fun. We have the best time. I'm in the work room, it's the best." From premiere details to how to watch, keep reading for everything you need to know about this iconic fashion competition. Fans can catch "Project Runway" on Freeform starting Thursday, July 31, at 10 p.m. ET. Episodes will also be available for streaming on Hulu and Disney+ after they air on Freeform. Heidi Klum is back as host with beloved winner and mentor Christian Siriano guiding the designers throughout the competition. This season features two influential voices in fashion: celebrity stylist Law Roach and Elle magazine's editor-in-chief Nina García. If the eight remaining episodes air as scheduled, the season finale is set for Thursday, Oct. 2. However, a potential one-week hiatus for hometown visits could push the finale back by a week. "Project Runway" season 21 premieres on Freeform July 31 and will be available to stream on Hulu and Disney+ afterward. The Walt Disney Co. is the parent company of ABC News and Hulu.
